StarshotStarshot

Capture · Annotate · Pin

v0.3.3

A local-first desktop tool for screenshots, annotation, pinned images and image styling. Capture your inspiration.

Starshot uses Rust / Tauri 2 / Vue 3 / TypeScript. Its Chinese interface and five themes follow the constellation series. It is a standalone product without a desktop pet. Current version: 0.3.3, available through in-app updates, targeting macOS and Windows.

The browser preview supports importing, annotating, styling and downloading images. Screenshots shown there are labeled original examples. Actual desktop capture and pinned images require the native app.

RustTauri 2Vue 3macOS 12+Windows x64

Main features

  • Capture: freeze multiple displays on demand and snap to window edges. Select, resize in eight directions, drag, adjust by 1px / 10px with the keyboard, use a magnifier and read HEX colors. Delay capture by 3 / 5 / 10 seconds or import PNG / JPEG / WebP.
  • Annotate below the selection with arrows, rectangles, ellipses, brush strokes, highlights, text, numbered markers, pixelation and solid redaction. Undo, redo, copy, save or pin; choose More editing to enter the full editor.
  • Sensitive data: run local detection for phone numbers, email addresses, IDs, bank cards and common credentials, then review and select solid redactions. macOS supports Chinese and English; Windows mainly supports Latin text and digits. Decorative backgrounds are excluded; review for missed data.
  • Style and export: gradients, solid colors, transparency or local image backgrounds, with padding, rounded corners, borders and shadows. Use adaptive, 1:1, 4:3, 16:9 or 9:16 canvases. One Canvas pipeline previews and exports PNG / JPEG at 1× / 2×.
  • Pinned images: drag, resize, rotate, flip, adjust opacity and hide the toolbar. Double-click to close, or right-click to copy, save as or open in the editor.
  • Scrolling capture: stitch downward or to the right. Start auto-scroll explicitly, pause with Esc / Space or add captures manually. Auto mode stops on an unstable page or stitching failure while preserving existing results.
  • Appearance and background use: five constellation themes and custom colors, configurable global shortcuts, optional startup at login and launch to tray. Check updates manually in settings, then download, verify signatures and confirm installation and restart.

README shortcuts: ⌘/Ctrl + Shift + 2 starts capture; ⌘/Ctrl + Alt + 3 pins the latest original screenshot. In the editor, ⌘/Ctrl + S exports, ⌘/Ctrl + Z undoes and ⌘/Ctrl + Shift + Z redoes. macOS requires Screen Recording permission for the first capture. Persistent screenshot history is not planned; Starclip handles long-term clipboard history.

The README lists pending work or verification: real cross-app control detection, scrolling capture on complex pages, standalone full-text OCR and a Windows Chinese model, continuous selections across displays, pinned-image groups and GIFs. Upward and leftward scrolling capture are not supported. Starshot does not claim full feature parity with reference products.

Current version: v0.3.3

Starshot v0.3.3 was released on November 11, 2026, with Apple Silicon macOS and Windows x64 installers.

  • The project and in-app updates moved to the StarDreamTech organization repository.
  • The About page and sharing posters use the new organization address and branding.
  • The organization Homebrew tap is available; the original personal tap remains usable.

Highlights from v0.3.2

The following is based on the published Starshot v0.3.2 release notes, published on GitHub on November 10, 2026 at 16:26 UTC. Older versions need to download the update and confirm Install and restart to use the new interactions.

  • New scrolling screenshots stitch downward or to the right. Users explicitly start auto-scroll or add captures manually. Pause to copy, save, pin or continue editing.
  • Capture controls: right-click to reselect, then exit; Tab / Shift+Tab moves through candidate levels; H toggles guides; C copies the original pixel color.
  • With existing Accessibility permission, macOS queries only control roles and geometry, not interface text. Capture overlays on macOS 27 and later protect system hot corners, with a conservative fallback on older systems.
  • Settings are organized into five tabs with a separate theme entry. Shortcuts support key recording and conflict checks. The tray adds groups, pinned-image visibility and counts, and shortcut pausing for the current run.
  • Preview sharing text and original product images before confirming a copy. macOS still uses ad-hoc signing without Apple notarization; Windows has no publisher certificate.

Supported platforms

  • Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 12+Homebrew Cask and a DMG in the release. macOS uses the system Vision framework for local recognition without a separate model download.
  • Windows x64An NSIS installer in the release includes an approximately 12.2 MB offline OCR model, mainly for Latin text and digits.

Both platforms use separate Tauri update signatures, which are not Apple notarization or Windows publisher signatures. The README provides no Intel Mac or Linux installer.

Install

Use the StarDreamTech Homebrew tap, as on the organization home page:

brew install --cask stardreamtech/tap/starshot

The installation section in the project README currently lists the personal tap: brew install --cask cpython666/tap/starshot. This page and the organization home page use the organization tap command above.

Find the Windows x64 installer and macOS DMG in the 0.3.3 release:

  • Starshot_0.3.3_aarch64.dmg Apple Silicon macOS
  • Starshot_0.3.3_x64-setup.exe Windows x64

The macOS app is not Apple-notarized and may be blocked on first launch. Read the release notes and verify SHA256SUMS. Version 0.1.0 has no in-app updater and requires a manual upgrade to access the update channel.
